findings.failing_input: OAuth response body contains a long error payload (>400 chars). Code truncates to body.slice(0, 400).
findings.actual: Correct truncation. However, if the body contains the actual client_secret echoed back by Shopify (defensive against bug in Shopify), this would leak. Shopify does NOT echo client_secret in OAuth responses, so this is safe.
findings.fix_sketch: Defensive: strip any 'client_secret=' substrings from errBody before logging.
findings.regression_test_idea: Test that error message does not contain the client_secret value (currently uncovered).

findings.failing_input: Concurrent invocations of getShopifyAccessToken for the same storeId when the cache is cold. Both await the same OAuth POST; both succeed and write the cache. Race condition: 2 OAuth calls happen instead of 1.
findings.expected: Only one OAuth call should be in-flight per storeId at a time (singleflight pattern).
findings.actual: No mutex / in-flight promise. Two concurrent callers will both hit the OAuth endpoint. Cost: one extra OAuth call (~300ms each). Shopify likely tolerates duplicates. Not a correctness bug, but wasteful.
findings.fix_sketch: Add an in-flight promise map: `const inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<string>>(); ... if (inFlight.has(storeId)) return inFlight.get(storeId); const p = doFetch(); inFlight.set(storeId, p); try { return await p; } finally { inFlight.delete(storeId); }`
findings.regression_test_idea: Concurrent Promise.all of 5 getShopifyAccessToken calls — assert fetch was called only once.

findings.failing_input: Token issued with expires_in=86399 (24h). At second 86340 (60s before expiry), code re-exchanges. Inside a long-running cron call that started at second 86341 and reads the token mid-execution — refresh happens.
findings.expected: 60s margin prevents expired-token 401s during in-flight calls.
findings.actual: Correct. Test 5 covers the cache hit path but not the expiry path explicitly.
findings.regression_test_idea: Test that mocking Date.now to expiresAt - 30000 (within margin) causes a re-fetch.

findings.failing_input: Shopify returns 200 with `{ access_token: 'foo' }` but no `expires_in` field.
findings.expected: Throws clear error with response shape.
findings.actual: Correct: `if (!data.access_token || !data.expires_in)` throws. However, `expires_in: 0` would also trigger this (falsy). For Shopify's 24h tokens, this is never 0 in practice, but the check is overly strict.
findings.regression_test_idea: Mock OAuth returning { access_token: 'x', expires_in: 0 } — assert throws OR is accepted (whichever is desired).

findings.actual: Correct (.slice(0, 400) returns full string if length <= 400).

uncertainty_notes: File is 110 LOC. Tests are 7 comprehensive cases covering: missing each env var, OAuth POST body, cache hit, cache miss after expiry (implicitly), error response, multi-store isolation. The concurrent-call singleflight pattern is not implemented but is the main MAJOR gap. Verdict ✅ overall — correctness is solid; SVC-02 is a perf/efficiency concern not a correctness bug.
